corrected_paragraph: The local agent uses Ollama `qwen3-silentshift:4b-instruct` with a six-iteration session limit. The current [`Investigator`](https://github.com/himanshu748/silentshift/blob/main/src/SilentShift/AI/Investigator.cls) requests at most **192 output tokens per exchange**; the [`provider ingress`](https://github.com/himanshu748/silentshift/blob/main/src/SilentShift/Provider/API.cls) independently rejects budgets above **700 tokens**. The admission ceiling is separate from the configured request budget, and neither is a measured session total. The enclosing production wait is separately bounded; expiry leaves the case held. That timeout does not establish that the provider has cancelled its work.
